description: This Java class `KafkaPublisherActor` is responsible for publishing messages into a Kafka broker within an Eclipse Ditto connectivity service. It manages Kafka producer lifecycle, constructs Kafka producer records from external messages, handles message sending asynchronously with callbacks, and manages connection states and error handling for Kafka communication.

classes.name: KafkaPublisherActor
classes.description: An Akka actor responsible for publishing external messages to Kafka, managing Kafka producer lifecycle, and handling message acknowledgment and error scenarios.

classes.name: KafkaPublishTarget
classes.description: Represents the Kafka topic, partition, and key for publishing messages.

classes.name: ProducerCallBack
classes.description: Callback implementation for Kafka message production, handling success and failure notifications, and generating acknowledgments.

classes.name: KafkaExceptionConverter
classes.description: Converts Kafka exceptions into appropriate HTTP status codes and acknowledgment responses.

classes.name: GracefulStop
classes.description: Sentinel object to trigger graceful stopping of the Kafka publisher actor.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Akka Props for instantiating KafkaPublisherActor.

methods.name: postStop
methods.description: Handles actor shutdown, closing the Kafka producer.

methods.name: getExceptionConverter
methods.description: Provides the exception to acknowledgment converter instance.

methods.name: preEnhancement
methods.description: Defines message handling for dry run messages and graceful stop signals.

methods.name: shouldPublishAcknowledgement
methods.description: Determines whether to publish acknowledgment based on its label.

methods.name: toPublishTarget
methods.description: Converts a target address string into a KafkaPublishTarget object.

methods.name: publishMessage
methods.description: Publishes a message to Kafka asynchronously, returning a future of command response.

methods.name: escalateIfNotRetryable
methods.description: Escalates non-retriable exceptions, typically to logging or error handling.

methods.name: stopInternalKafkaProducer
methods.description: Stops and closes the Kafka producer.

methods.name: reportInitialConnectionState
methods.description: Logs initial connection state and signals readiness.

methods.name: stopGracefully
methods.description: Triggers graceful shutdown of actor and Kafka producer.

methods.name: producerRecord
methods.description: Builds a Kafka ProducerRecord from external message and publish target.

methods.name: mapExternalMessageHeaders
methods.description: Converts ExternalMessage headers into Kafka headers.

methods.name: mapExternalMessagePayload
methods.description: Extracts payload from ExternalMessage depending on message type.

methods.name: ackFromMetadata
methods.description: Creates an Acknowledgement object from Kafka RecordMetadata.

methods.name: toPayload
methods.description: Constructs a JSON payload with Kafka metadata for acknowledgment.

methods.name: isQuotaSufficient
methods.description: Checks whether message size fits within quota for acknowledgment payload.
